thresholds.public_label: Days below CT 3.06 total nursing HPRD
thresholds.short_caveat: Used for PBJ320 daily staffing screening on facility pages.
thresholds.methodology_caveat: MACPAC state compendium: 3.06 HPRD total estimated staffing. CT Public Act (eff. Oct 2021, Sec. 10) directed DPH to set nursing home minimums often summarized as ~3.0 direct-care hours per resident per day. PBJ320 applies the 3.06 benchmark to total reported nursing HPRD (all PBJ nursing roles incl. admin/DON), not Nurse_Care_HPRD alone.

thresholds.public_label: CT total nursing HPRD daily screen
thresholds.short_caveat: MACPAC estimated total staffing requirement used for PBJ daily screening.
thresholds.methodology_caveat: Connecticut law may reference direct-care hour minimums separately. PBJ320 applies this benchmark to total reported nursing HPRD.
thresholds.source_url_or_note: MACPAC state staffing compendium (2022); CT Public Act direct-care minimums

thresholds.public_label: Days below NY 3.50 direct care HPRD
thresholds.short_caveat: Used for PBJ320 daily staffing screening on NY facility pages.
thresholds.methodology_caveat: PBJ320 screens reported PBJ direct-care HPRD (RN, LPN, CNA, nurse aide trainee, medication aide; excludes DON and nursing admin) against N.Y. Public Health Law § 2895-b’s 3.50 HPRD total component. Role mapping is informative—not an enforcement determination.

thresholds.public_label: NY MACPAC total nursing reference (3.56 HPRD)
thresholds.short_caveat: MACPAC estimated total staffing reference for charts only; not used for NY daily screening.
thresholds.methodology_caveat: MACPAC compendium estimate including DON/admin. NY facility-page daily screening uses § 2895-b direct care at 3.50 HPRD instead.

thresholds.public_label: CMS 2001 expert panel recommendation (total direct care)
thresholds.short_caveat: Influential research benchmark, not a binding federal rule.
thresholds.methodology_caveat: CMS convened an expert panel in 2001; facilities are not required to meet 4.1 HPRD.

thresholds.short_caveat: Proposed federal minimum staffing rule; numeric standards were rescinded and are not enforced.
thresholds.methodology_caveat: Courts vacated key portions and Congress imposed a moratorium; facilities remain subject to pre-2024 federal requirements.

thresholds.short_caveat: Long-standing federal requirement; often cited near 0.3 HPRD for a typical 100-bed facility.
thresholds.methodology_caveat: Federal regulation requires licensed nurse coverage and an RN director of nursing onsite; PBJ320 may display approximate HPRD equivalents for context.
